user_story: As a user, I want registration to fail if I leave any field empty so that incomplete accounts are not created.

positive.title: Successful registration with all fields filled
steps: Fill in all required fields with valid data
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered and redirected to the homepage

negative.title: Registration fails when username field is empty
steps: Fill in other required fields with valid data
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the username is required

negative.title: Registration fails when email field is empty
steps: Fill in username with valid data
Fill in other required fields with valid data
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is required

negative.title: Registration fails when password field is empty
steps: Fill in username and email with valid data
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the password is required

edge.title: Registration fails with leading and trailing spaces in username
steps: Enter a username with leading and trailing spaces
Fill in other required fields with valid data
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the username is required or invalid
